create_JambaToolParser: create a JambaToolParser instance with a tokenizer and optional tools list for parsing Jamba model tool calls
extract_tool_calls: extract tool calls from a Jamba model output string by parsing <tool_calls> tags and JSON content
extract_tool_calls_streaming: extract streaming tool calls from incremental text and token deltas for real-time Jamba model responses
adjust_request: adjust a ChatCompletionRequest or ResponsesRequest to disable special token skipping for Jamba tool calls
test_JambaToolParser: test the JambaToolParser class with mock tokenizer and tools to verify tool call extraction
